verdict.rationale: Loops documents managing mailing lists programmatically: its official MCP server lets agents "manage contacts and mailing lists" (loops-docs-24, loops-docs-40). Contacts can be created and updated via the API (loops-docs-4, loops-docs-35). Segments are described only as dynamic dashboard objects, with no documented create/update endpoint (loops-docs-16, loops-docs-31). No evidence shows an API that reads back the exact membership of a list or segment. missing for 10: documented API endpoints to create/update lists and segments, an endpoint to enumerate list or segment members, any tag support, independent corroboration.
